messages:
mika.s: heads-up — launching a joint marketplace listing + webinar with NimbusCloud. need quick owners for landing, routing, and post-webinar assets.
raj.gtm: I can own landing + registration. prefer Thu 9am PT. 40m total: 10 demo / 12 panel / 12 q&a / 6 CTAs.
carmen.prod: i'll do the demo and request an engineering bench report (latency, cost per 1k tokens) to cite in the blog. ask eng to send conservative numbers.
mika.s: messaging — two hero lines please: one product-focused, one exec-focused. Carmen, can you draft short benchmark blurb for hero?
carmen.prod: draft in thread: "Reduce token cost and median latency with workload-aware batching across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments." will refine.
raj.gtm: routing rules: utm_source=nimbus_market OR source=="nimbus_listing" => add to MKTO_Nimbus_Apr2026; high-intent leads (company_size>200 & intent>60) => assign SDR Pool 1.
opsbot: Automation: created Marketo list MKTO_Nimbus_Apr2026. Sync job 9123 scheduled daily.
mika.s: partner assets needed: logo (PNG), 1-sentence quote, and 20-30s clip by Wed EOD. legal already signed.
raj.gtm: AB test CTAs: "Start free trial" vs "Schedule private demo". 50/50. we'll track conversion to demo requests.
carmen.prod: rehearsal Friday 11am PT. demo will switch infra modes in <90s to show parity. also preparing a one-pager for SDRs.
mika.s: post-webinar: publish blog with benchmark narrative + recording, clip socials, and run a nurture sequence. owners: blog=mika, socials=raj, SDR one-pager=carmen.
opsbot: Reminder: calendar invite and rehearsal link sent. Event ID 10456.
raj.gtm: i'll spin up the landing tonight and tag you for copy review.
mika.s: thanks team — follow-ups here. :rocket:
